<STBG 3,0><CHAR 1,0,1,0,2><CHAR 5,0,23,0,0><CV 1,90><NAME 1><TALK 1>Hm? Hunter, there's something here.
Wanted posters of great criminals...?
Let me see...

<CV 1,63>And more...
「Crime of Flaunting the Flesh」 Sage,
「Crime of Always Wearing Shoes」 Argo...

<NAME 31><TALK 5><CV 21,11>「Crime of a Strange Dialect」 Amenoma!?
I'll give you a beating!

<CHAR 5,2,23,0,0><CHAR 5,5,7,0,0><NAME 10><TALK 5><CV 5,21><BGM 0,500,505>That odd poster is the work of the
Dronneko gang! It bears on our reputation,
so I want you to deal with it at once!

<CHAR 1,0,1,0,0><CV 5,27><ITEM PCOIN00163,1,1>They go around the taverns of each land,
handing out posters! Inspect the <COL C70101FF>leftovers</COL>
they leave and grasp their trail!

<ITEM WD_STICK162,1,1>Also, they've recreated gear used by
a legendary knight order and prepared it
with the Nyan Search Corps!

A treasure worthy of the name divine —
do make use of it!

<ITEM AD_BODY2135,1,1>Further, as for armour, guild craft lets
you evolve it into any form you like.
Evolve it actively!

(What intensity...
As expected, your sense of justice
is second to none.)

My cute little one is pitiable...
Right, Mit-chan? Yes, indeed.
